scenes.time: Fourth day of travel; grey twilight under a heaving surface, later low bruised sky and walls of rain
scenes.key_moment: Dace's four-coloured patched boat sitting on the swell like a duck, with her weathered face, pipe and string-tied hat over the side (c08.s01.p006.1-3)

backgrounds: open sea at the south edge of the Belt, grey twilight
open sea under bruised sky with rain walls

scenes.time: Day, through storm then calm Eyes under a ring of blue sky
scenes.key_moment: The boat turning on green glass water in an Eye, a ring of blue sky and the storm standing round like a wall (c08.s02.p002.8-9, c08.s02.p005.2)

backgrounds: boat in an Eye of the storm, green glass water, blue sky ring, cloud wall
boat in black rain and grey sea hills

scenes.key_moment: Saltgate rising from the rain: a hundred black sea-stacks hung with tiers of building like nests, neon signs forty metres high breaking on black water (c08.s03.p003.1-9)

backgrounds: Saltgate skyline from the water, evening rain, neon
canal lock with open rusted iron gates and Lockkeeper glass boxes
canal wall with wanted poster of Ilan Voss
expressions: Sefa awestruck, face lit by changing colours

scenes.time: Day in the market; that night in the rain at the Sluice
scenes.key_moment: The Wet Market basin, three tiers of stalls with the lowest a metre under water, lamps on chains, water full of light and legs (c08.s04.p002.1-7)

backgrounds: Wet Market basin, three tiers, lamps on chains
the Sluice, narrow back canal with washing and leaning tenements, night rain

scenes.time: Evening in the noodle shop; later the rescue inside the tower
scenes.key_moment: The Wellwalker floating curled in a glass cylinder of orphan water, tubes in her arms, grey hair moving, eyes open (c08.s05.p020.1-4)

backgrounds: noodle shop window across the canal from the tower
Brightwater Wellness Centre exterior, white tiles, fountain, blue drop and sun sign

scenes.time: Three days after the rescue, then nine days of lessons
scenes.key_moment: Ilan waist deep in the canal with a cupful of water between his palms, the water going warm as he thinks of Dace's crushed foot (c08.s06.p011.1, c08.s06.p013.1-3, c08.s06.p014.1)

backgrounds: shadows under the Wet Market, clean tide water, pilings

scenes.time: Days and nights over nine days, lamps dimmed on the sixth night, last evening by the canal
scenes.key_moment: The porter laying his limp daughter in Sefa's arms, then the child sitting up in the basin and asking for noodles (c08.s07.p007.1-2, c08.s07.p008.1-4)

backgrounds: lowest tier of the Wet Market with plank table and two basins
canal with wanted poster on the wall across
